quote_a: The indoor speed limit is 12 km/h
quote_b: Inside the building the limit is 10 km/h
explanation: Chapter 6 sets the indoor limit at 12 km/h while chapter 13 sets it at 10 km/h; the canon (F-LIM-01) says 10 km/h.

quote_a: Chilled deliveries are accepted at up to +10 °C
quote_b: The cold zone never rises above +8 °C
explanation: Receiving accepts chilled goods up to +10 °C, but storage never allows above +8 °C (F-LIM-09).

quote_a: Returns are inspected in Zone D
quote_b: Returns staff inspect goods in Zone F
explanation: Returns inspection is placed in Zone D in chapter 7 and in Zone F in chapter 8; the canon (F-ZON-14) says Zone F.

quote_a: The shift supervisor approves all write-offs
quote_b: Write-offs above 500 EUR need the warehouse manager
explanation: Chapter 8 gives all write-offs to the supervisor, but chapter 14 requires the manager above 500 EUR (F-RSP-02, F-RSP-03).

quote_a: Items are packed first and scanned afterwards
quote_b: Picked items are scanned before they are packed
explanation: Chapter 12 packs before scanning while chapter 3 scans before packing; the canon (F-ORD-05) requires scan first.

quote_a: Each rack bay carries up to 3,000 kg
quote_b: Never place more than 2,700 kg in a single bay
explanation: Bay capacity is 3,000 kg in chapter 2 but 2,700 kg in chapter 6; the canon (F-LIM-07) says 2,700 kg.

quote_b: Stock controllers run the PR-08 cycle counts
explanation: Chapter 5 points cycle counts at PR-09 (damaged goods) while chapter 8 correctly points at PR-08.

quote_a: Evacuation walkways keep their full 1.2 m width
explanation: Walkway width is 1.2 m in chapter 9 but 1.5 m in chapter 13; the canon (F-LIM-13) says 1.2 m.

quote_a: The credit note is issued before inspection
quote_b: No credit is issued before the inspection is complete
explanation: Chapter 7 issues credit before inspection while chapter 14 forbids it; the canon (F-ORD-06) requires inspection first.
